findings: The learning outcomes (PDF 17-18) are not reproduced; the definition of a transition element follows them.

The book says the elements are called transition elements 'because they show transitions between variable oxidation states'; the name is usually explained by their position between the s and p blocks. The sentence is not carried.
The book names scandium as excluded but explains only zinc; the reason for scandium (Sc3+ is 3d0) is taken from Quick Check 18.1.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content.
